sessionStart.powershell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '.copilot' | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path '.copilot/session.log' -Value "[Copilot] Session started: $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')"

preToolUse.bash:
#!/bin/sh
# Block destructive commands on protected branches/files
INPUT=$(cat)
COMMAND=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo '')
ARGS=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(str(d.get('args','')))" 2>/dev/null || echo '')
# Block rm -rf on source directories
if echo "$ARGS" | grep -qE 'rm.*-rf.*(src|lib|app|components)'; then
  echo '{"decision":"deny","reason":"Blocked destructive rm -rf on source directory"}'
  exit 0
fi
# Allow everything else
echo '{"decision":"allow"}'

postToolUse.bash: INPUT=$(cat); TOOL=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool','unknown'))" 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'); echo "[$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] tool=$TOOL" >> .copilot/tool-audit.log 2>/dev/null || true
